agent_1_answer.reasoning: In this scenario, which appears to be a version of the Ultimatum Game, I would accept the 50/50 split. While the proposal is perfectly fair and gives me exactly half the total amount, in game theory terms this is a rational choice. If I reject, I would receive nothing, which is worse than receiving $50. The proposer has offered an equitable division, so there is no strategic reason to punish them by rejecting the offer.
